## Joining USDM data

This script focuses on joining USDM data to PRF grids in selected states

## inputs

```{r}

start_year <- 2010
end_year <- 2025

high_drought_threshold <- 4

interval_start_months <- 1:11
names(interval_start_months) <- 625:635

interval_end_months <- 2:12
names(interval_end_months) <- 625:635

```




## load grids data 

```{r}

load(file = here("data/outputs/grids_intersecting.rda"))

years <- start_year:end_year
suffixes <- 625:635

# Build pattern
year_pattern <- paste0(years, collapse = "|")
suffix_pattern <- paste0(suffixes, collapse = "|")
regex_pattern <- paste0("^cpc_index_(", year_pattern, ")_(", suffix_pattern, ")$")

grids <- grids_intersecting %>% select(GRIDCODE, STATE, lon, lat, matches(regex_pattern))


```






Unzip all USDM .zip files

```{r}
unzipped <- FALSE

if(unzipped == FALSE){
    # Set root directory where all the year folders are located
  root_dir <- here("data/USDM_GIS")
  
  # Get all subfolders matching the pattern
  folders <- list.dirs(root_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  target_folders <- folders[grepl("_USDM_M", basename(folders))]
  print(target_folders)
  # Loop through each folder
  for (folder in target_folders) {
    # List all zip files in the folder
    zip_files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)
    
    # Extract each zip file to the same folder
    for (zip in zip_files) {
      unzip(zip, exdir = folder)
    }
  }
}


```




Load individual USDM shapefiles, extract values to grids in AOI
```{r}

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

grids_pt <- grids %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% st_as_sf(., coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)



for (year in years) {
  print(paste0("processing year ", year))
  # Get list of all shapefiles for the year
  year_shps <- list.files(here(paste0("data/USDM_GIS/", year, "_USDM_M")),
                         pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  for (shp in year_shps) {
    # Extract date from file name using regex (expects format like USDM_YYYYMMDD.shp)
    usdm_date <- str_extract(basename(shp), "\\d{8}")
    print(usdm_date)
    # Read shapefile
    a <- st_read(shp, quiet = TRUE)
    
    # Prepare grids points (assuming grids is available in environment)
    grids_pt <- grids %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
    
    # Spatial join and keep only DM column renamed with date
    grids_joined <- st_join(grids_pt, a, left = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(DM = coalesce(DM, -1)) %>%
      select(DM) %>%
      rename(!!paste0("DM_", usdm_date) := DM)
    
    grids[[paste0("DM_", usdm_date)]]  <- grids_joined[[paste0("DM_", usdm_date)]]
  }
}

save(grids, file = here("data/grids_usdm"))

rm(grids_joined, grids_pt)

```

```{r}
  geom_sf(aes(col = DM_20250211)) +

  theme_minimal()


```

## calculater per interval stats (mean, median, max, high_drought_pct)


```{r}
years <- start_year:end_year
intervals <- 625:635
interval_start_months <- 1:11
names(interval_start_months) <- 625:635

interval_end_months <- 2:12
names(interval_end_months) <- 625:635

interval_df <- expand.grid("interval" = intervals, "year" = years)

interval_df$start_month <- interval_start_months[as.character(interval_df$interval)]
interval_df$end_month <- interval_end_months[as.character(interval_df$interval)]

interval_df$start_date <- paste0(interval_df$year, "-", str_pad(interval_df$start_month, 2, "left", "0"), "-01")
interval_df$end_date <- paste0(interval_df$year, "-", str_pad(interval_df$end_month, 2, "left", "0"), "-31")



for(k in 1:nrow(interval_df)){
  current_year <- interval_df$year[k]
  current_interval <- interval_df$interval[k]
  current_start_month <- str_pad(interval_df$start_month[k], 2, "left", "0")
  current_end_month <- str_pad(interval_df$end_month[k], 2, "left", "0")
  
  print(paste0("processing ", current_year, " ", current_interval))

  # Select all columns starting with year + start month or year + end month
  dm_columns <- c(
    names(grids)[startsWith(names(grids), paste0("DM_", current_year, current_start_month))],
    names(grids)[startsWith(names(grids), paste0("DM_", current_year, current_end_month))]
  ) %>% unique()  # remove duplicates if any

  median_column_name <- paste0("DM_median_", current_year, "_", current_interval)
  max_column_name <- paste0("DM_max_", current_year, "_", current_interval)
  mean_column_name <- paste0("DM_mean_", current_year, "_", current_interval)
  high_drought_pct_column_name <- paste0("DM_high_pct_", current_year, "_", current_interval)
  
  
  grids <- grids %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      dm_values = list(c_across(all_of(dm_columns))),
      # create columns with dynamic names using :=
      !!max_column_name := max(dm_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!median_column_name := median(dm_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!mean_column_name := mean(dm_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!high_drought_pct_column_name := sum(dm_values >= high_drought_threshold)/length(dm_values)

    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-dm_values)  # remove temp column if not needed
}

save(grids, file = here("data/outputs/grids_usdm_stats.rda"))


```
